RagShortTexts: Berber lancers wielding oryx-hide adarga shields formed the swift desert vanguard of the.

Variants.Content: Rising from the Moroccan steppe, the Zenata Berber warriors of the Marinid Sultanate and their loyal Black Guard transformed North African warfare. Carrying hard heart-shaped oryx-hide adarga bucklers and slender light lances, these agile riders mounted agile Barb stallions to outmaneuver Christian heavy cavalry.
Controlling trans-Saharan gold caravans, Marinid sultans fielded professional retinues pledged to holy war, preparing incursions across the Gibraltar strait to preserve Moorish Andalusia.
Adarga shields of cured antelope hide deflect arrows effortlessly under the desert sun. Rather than locking knee-to-knee, Berber lancers swirl like dust devils, skewering gaps in enemy armor.
